_readme: Solder-joint goals (mm) per IPC-7351B family and density (M=Most, N=Nominal, L=Least). Values marked 'cross-checked' were confirmed in two or more independent sources (see manual, IPC chapter). null means NOT CONFIGURED: the calculator refuses to use it. Fill null values from your licensed copy of IPC-7351B (or your company standard) in config/ipc/company_goals.json, which overrides this file key by key.

tolerances._note: F = board fabrication tolerance, P = placement tolerance (mm). Defaults follow the IPC-7351 worked example (land profile 0.05 x 2, placement 0.1 true position). Adjust to your fabricator and assembler capability.

rounding._note: Z and X are rounded up, G is rounded down, so rounding never reduces the solder fillet.

chip_ge_1608.description: Rectangular or square-end chip components, body 1608 metric (0603) and larger

chip_lt_1608.status: nominal only - confirm with licensed standard
sources: IPC technical paper E6&S17 (toe 0.20, courtyard 0.15, round-off 0.01)

gullwing_pitch_gt_0625.description: Gull-wing leads, pitch greater than 0.625 mm (SOIC, SOP, SOT, QFP)

gullwing_pitch_le_0625.description: Gull-wing leads, pitch 0.625 mm or less
gullwing_pitch_le_0625.status: not configured - sources disagree on side goals; enter from licensed standard

nolead.status: nominal from a single secondary source - confirm with licensed standard
sources: Secondary source quoting IPC-7351 nominal QFN goals
